page: Microsoft Azure E8-2ads_v5 is a constrained-vCPU memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz. It provides 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to a single physical core with two threads per core. The instance is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding an unusually dense ratio of 32.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, with x86_64 instruction extensions including AVX, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI, though AVX-512 extensions are absent. Local storage is bundled as a 322 GB SSD, while dedicated GPU hardware is not included.

Benchmark measurements reflect the specific performance profile of a dual-thread configuration backed by a high-frequency core. Single-core compute capability is prominent, demonstrated by a stress-ng single-core score of 2696.08 in the upper tier and a Geekbench single-core score of 1580.0. Conversely, multithreaded capacity is constrained by the 2-vCPU count, resulting in low comparative scores across multi-core benchmarks such as PassMark CPU (3136.94) and Geekbench multi-core (1972.0). Uncached memory throughput measures 31.81 GB/sec for large read operations and 22.36 GB/sec for writes, placing uncached memory bandwidth in the lower tiers.

This constrained core configuration provides a specialized architectural tradeoff that maximizes memory capacity while limiting per-core software licensing costs. By retaining 64 GB of RAM on only two vCPUs, workloads that are licensed per core but demand high memory tables achieve substantial cost efficiency. The integrated 322 GB local SSD provides high-speed scratch space directly attached to the hypervisor.

The E8-2ads_v5 is appropriate for enterprise database engines, in-memory caches, analytics caches, and memory-bound ETL tasks that do not require heavy parallel computational throughput but require extensive memory allocations and moderate core counts.
description: Microsoft Azure E8-2ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine engineered with a high memory-to-vCPU ratio. Built on an AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz, it allocates 2 dedicated vCPUs on 1 physical core alongside 64.0 GB of RAM and 322 GB of local SSD storage. Benchmark evaluations highlight strong single-core compute performance alongside lower multi-threaded throughput, reflecting its limited core count. Memory bandwidth reaches 31.81 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 22.36 GB/sec for writes. The system omits dedicated GPU accelerators. This hardware configuration is targeted at core-licensed relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and lightweight data pipelines where high RAM capacity is prioritized over parallel processing power.
